messages.subject: Thai Airways | Sustainable aviation, institutional relations and transformation
messages.body:
Dear Thai Airways Executive Leadership Team,

Thai Airways' transformation and sustainability agenda requires strong coordination across government, regulators, operations and external stakeholders. That is the type of environment in which I operate today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate covers government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate coordination, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy. I also work with civil aviation authorities as part of the operating interfaces supporting a remote mine.

My recent experience includes major energy-transition and carbon-governance work alongside high-scrutiny regulatory coordination and executive communications. I bring a disciplined approach to turning external requirements into clear internal ownership and documented delivery.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional responsibilities in Corporate Affairs, Sustainability, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or transformation leadership. I have attached a Thai Airways-focused executive CV and would appreciate your routing it to the relevant senior team.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
